paper_title: Search of spin-dependent fifth forces with precision magnetometry
suggested_experiment_name: SQUID magnetometry spin-dependent fifth force (GSO paramagnet)
coupling_convention: g_p^e * g_s^N product, dimensionless (plotted as spin-mass interaction constant)
notes: Search for monopole-dipole (spin-mass) fifth force with SQUID magnetometry and paramagnetic GSO crystals. Best quoted 95% C.L. limit g_p^e g_s^N <= 5.7e-32 for lambda >~ 10 cm (m <~ 2 ueV); also g_p^e g_s^e <= 1.6e-31. The exclusion spans lambda ~1 cm to 10 m and 10 km to 300 km (mass ~2e-5 eV down to ~6.6e-13 eV). For large lambda the potential is 1/r^2 (mass-independent), so the ~5.7e-32 bound is roughly flat toward small masses; encoded as a horizontal line. Full mass-dependent curve is only in Fig. 4 (not numerically readable); values here taken from text.
